theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+1.81%) and Materials (+0.82%) led the market today, while Utilities (-4.20%) and Industrials (-1.05%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.32%, defensives -1.61%, and value/cyclicals +0.00% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.33%, Dow -0.70%, Nasdaq -0.12% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.54%. The VIX rose 3.47% to 14.92, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.64% to $4,500.40, crude oil was little changed at $86.65, and bitcoin slipped 0.13% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
